title: RA/FGF mutual-inhibition switch (BIOMD0000000275): where the bistable boundary sits when synthesis rates change
evidence_kind: SIMULATED: published-model ODE dynamics, not fit to fish data

model.name: libRoadRunner 2.11.0 CVODE, rtol 1e-10, deterministic; two initial states per position to detect bistability
model.context: Goldbeter-Gonze-Pourquie 2007 somitogenesis switch, swept at 51 positions x (0-50) for 8 parameter settings. Used here as a generic two-morphogen switch, NOT as a fin model.

time.units: model time units (unconverted); steady states only

numerical_checks.name: Cyp26 loss
numerical_checks.result: max |dy/dt| 7.1: NOT a steady state, RA accumulates without bound. Reported as a model defect, not a result.

parameter_unknowns: Every rate constant is the published model's; none measured in any fish.
open_questions: Does the boundary in a real fin bud show hysteresis, i.e. depend on treatment history?
limitations: The model has no Cyp26-independent RA clearance, so RA-degradation knockouts cannot be simulated in it.
Local sensitivity near this switch is not a derivative (see s3); the bistable window location is the usable output.
does_not_establish: any fin or limb bud boundary position (the model is a presomitic-mesoderm model in arbitrary position units)
that RA/FGF sets flying-fish pectoral fin proportions
the Cyp26-loss case, which never reached steady state and is reported as invalid
